thesis:
This run focused on maintaining strong entries in gold and copper mining. Great Pacific Gold Corp. was successfully opened with a long position due to its strong composite score of 80, driven by moderate gold grade at 4.95 g/t over 200m. The other top picks, GR Silver Mining Ltd., A2 Gold Corp., and Giant Mining Corp., were not reopened due to the churn guard cooldown from recent auto-rebalance actions.

No short positions were opened this run as there were no Red-Flag signals detected in critical categories for the wired oracle assets outside the top-N.
